synopsis: Shuumei has a problem. He’s in love with a girl who works at a maid cafe, but he’s too cool to go into a place like that without being embarrassed. In this delightful LGBT+ romcom, two young people in love are about to find out a lot about each other–and themselves. synopsis: Q: Why did you choose this high school? A: Because my future wife is enrolling here. When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past.
